biggest_catch: You need a suitable vehicle and insurance — and winning bids is competitive, never guaranteed.
catches: Requires a suitable vehicle/trailer and proper insurance; larger loads may need a CDL.
Competitive bidding — most quotes lose; ratings and reviews drive wins.
uShip takes a service fee on completed shipments — confirm the current fee schedule at signup.
Fuel, maintenance, and deadhead miles are your costs; underbidding can mean hauling at a loss.

c1.evidence: uShip's official homepage has a dedicated carrier channel: 'BECOME A CARRIER — Turn every mile into profit with uShip, where new shipments are listed every 30 seconds' — a real, public bidding marketplace connecting carriers with 35,000+ active carriers and secure uShip Payments.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed carrier pay range — carriers set their own quotes per shipment; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: register as a carrier, browse listed shipments, submit quotes, win, haul, get paid through uShip Payments.

c4.evidence: Carrier registration carries no upfront fee per official materials; uShip monetizes via service fees on completed shipments.

eligibility: Adults with a suitable vehicle/trailer and insurance who can legally haul; CDL for larger commercial loads.
notes: Scenario: transport/freight. uShip is a shipping marketplace: customers list shipments, carriers submit competing quotes, and winners haul and get paid through uShip Payments. Income is per-shipment and variable — never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: per-shipment carrier-set quotes, no official fixed range. time: carrier registration + profile/vehicle setup + bidding on first shipments, est. 45-90 min active.

steps: Register free as a carrier on uShip with your vehicle, insurance, and credentials.
Browse listed shipments (vehicles, furniture, freight, boats, equipment) matching your route.
Submit competitive quotes on shipments you can haul.
Win the bid, complete pickup and delivery, and get paid through uShip Payments (service fee applies).
timing: New shipments list continuously (~every 30 seconds); payment releases on delivery confirmation.
